     1	#!/usr/bin/env python3

     1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
     2	"""Real-time HL MARK collector (Alberto GO 2026-07-09): poll metaAndAssetCtxs every ~60s, timestamp it,
     3	store per-coin markPx (+oraclePx, midPx). From now on we have continuous 1-min marks -> the OOS is never
     4	blocked by the ~10-day asset_ctxs archive lag again.
     5	
     6	Source: https://api.hyperliquid.xyz/info {"type":"metaAndAssetCtxs"} -- ONE low-weight call/min (231 main-dex
     7	coins), zero 429 risk to the copy trader. (xyz/HIP-3 dexes need per-dex polls -> fast-follow, not here.)
     8	
     9	Output: app/data/hl_mark_1m_hot/{YYYYMMDD}.parquet  cols: coin,timestamp_utc(ms),markPx,oraclePx,midPx,source
    10	Resident loop; resumes the current UTC day on restart; flushes atomically every N polls + on day rollover +
    11	on SIGTERM/SIGINT. Read-only w.r.t. everything else. Companion loader: research/v15/live_marks.live_mark_at.
    12	"""
    13	from __future__ import annotations
    14	import argparse, logging, signal, sys, time
    15	from datetime import datetime, timezone
    16	from pathlib import Path
    17	from typing import Any
    18	
    19	import pandas as pd
    20	import requests
    21	
    22	REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
    23	OUT_DIR = REPO / "app" / "data" / "hl_mark_1m_hot"
    24	HL_API = "https://api.hyperliquid.xyz/info"
    25	# timestamp_utc is MINUTE-FLOORED (join key -> aligns with 1m candles/fills timestamp_utc, which are also
    26	# minute-floored). poll_ts_utc keeps the exact wall-clock poll instant for audit. (Alberto 2026-07-09:
    27	# "properly to the minute mark so it's joinable with the S3 backfill".)
    28	COLS = ["coin", "timestamp_utc", "poll_ts_utc", "markPx", "oraclePx", "midPx", "source"]
    29	LOG = logging.getLogger("hl_live_mark")
    30	
    31	_stop = False
    32	
    33	
    34	def _sig(*_a):
    35	    global _stop
    36	    _stop = True
    37	
    38	
    39	def day_id(ts_ms: int) -> str:
    40	    return datetime.fromtimestamp(ts_ms / 1000, tz=timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%d")
    41	
    42	
    43	def poll_once(session: requests.Session, ts_ms: int) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    44	    r = session.post(HL_API, json={"type": "metaAndAssetCtxs"}, timeout=15).json()
    45	    if not (isinstance(r, list) and len(r) == 2):
    46	        raise RuntimeError("metaAndAssetCtxs: unexpected response shape")
    47	    meta, ctxs = r[0], r[1]
    48	    uni = meta.get("universe", [])
    49	    minute_ms = (ts_ms // 60_000) * 60_000     # minute-floored join key (aligns with 1m candle grid)
    50	    rows = []
    51	    for u, c in zip(uni, ctxs):
    52	        coin = u.get("name")
    53	        if not coin or not isinstance(c, dict):
    54	            continue
    55	        mk = c.get("markPx")
    56	        if mk is None:
    57	            continue
    58	        rows.append({"coin": coin, "timestamp_utc": minute_ms, "poll_ts_utc": ts_ms, "markPx": str(mk),
    59	                     "oraclePx": str(c.get("oraclePx", "")), "midPx": str(c.get("midPx", "")),
    60	                     "source": "hl_api_metaAndAssetCtxs_1m"})
    61	    return rows
    62	
    63	
    64	def load_day(day: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    65	    fp = OUT_DIR / f"{day}.parquet"
    66	    if not fp.exists():
    67	        return []
    68	    try:
    69	        return pd.read_parquet(fp).to_dict("records")
    70	    except Exception as e:
    71	        # codex P1 (2026-07-10): do NOT swallow a read error and return [] — the next flush would then
    72	        # overwrite an existing day's marks with only the new (partial) buffer, silently truncating live
    73	        # history. Fail LOUD so KeepAlive surfaces it and an operator fixes/moves the bad file.
    74	        raise RuntimeError(
    75	            f"hl_live_mark_collector: existing day file {fp} is unreadable ({e!r}). Refusing to start empty "
    76	            f"and overwrite it. Move/repair the file, then let KeepAlive relaunch."
    77	        ) from e
    78	
    79	
    80	def flush_day(day: str, buf: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> None:
    81	    if not buf:
    82	        return
    83	    OUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    84	    df = pd.DataFrame(buf, columns=COLS).sort_values(["coin", "timestamp_utc"], kind="mergesort")
    85	    # dedup exact (coin, ts) in case of a restart-overlap poll
    86	    df = df.drop_duplicates(subset=["coin", "timestamp_utc"], keep="last")
    87	    fp = OUT_DIR / f"{day}.parquet"
    88	    tmp = fp.with_suffix(".parquet.tmp")
    89	    df.to_parquet(tmp, index=False, compression="snappy")
    90	    tmp.replace(fp)
    91	
    92	
    93	def main() -> int:
    94	    logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format="%(asctime)s [%(name)s] %(levelname)s: %(message)s",
    95	                        stream=sys.stdout, force=True)
    96	    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    97	    ap.add_argument("--interval", type=int, default=60, help="seconds between polls")
    98	    ap.add_argument("--flush-every", type=int, default=5, help="flush the day parquet every N polls")
    99	    ap.add_argument("--once", action="store_true", help="single poll then exit (testing)")
   100	    args = ap.parse_args()
   101	    signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, _sig)
   102	    signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, _sig)
   103	    session = requests.Session()
   104	
   105	    now_ms = int(time.time() * 1000)
   106	    cur_day = day_id(now_ms)
   107	    buf = load_day(cur_day)
   108	    LOG.info("start: interval=%ss flush_every=%s resumed_day=%s rows=%d", args.interval, args.flush_every, cur_day, len(buf))
   109	
   110	    if args.once:
   111	        buf.extend(poll_once(session, now_ms)); flush_day(cur_day, buf)
   112	        LOG.info("once: wrote %d rows to %s", len(buf), OUT_DIR / f"{cur_day}.parquet")
   113	        return 0
   114	
   115	    n = 0
   116	    while not _stop:
   117	        t0 = time.time()
   118	        ts_ms = int(t0 * 1000)
   119	        day = day_id(ts_ms)
   120	        if day != cur_day:                       # UTC day rollover -> flush + start fresh

    20	def roundtrips(fills):
    21	    """fills: list of (ts, coin, signed_size, price) ts-sorted. Yield round-trips per coin:
    22	    (dir, entry_ts, exit_ts, entry_vwap, exit_vwap, their_gross)."""
    23	    from collections import defaultdict
    24	    bycoin = defaultdict(list)
    25	    for ts, c, s, p in fills:
    26	        bycoin[c].append((ts, s, p))
    27	    out = []
    28	    for c, fl in bycoin.items():
    29	        pos = 0.0; en = es = ex = exs = 0.0; ets = None; cdir = 0
    30	        for ts, s, p in fl:
    31	            if p is None or p <= 0 or s is None or s == 0:
    32	                continue
    33	            if pos == 0 or (pos > 0) == (s > 0):           # open / add
    34	                if pos == 0:
    35	                    ets = ts; cdir = 1 if s > 0 else -1; en = es = ex = exs = 0.0
    36	                en += abs(s) * p; es += abs(s); pos += s
    37	            else:                                          # reduce / close / reverse
    38	                cl = min(abs(s), abs(pos))
    39	                ex += cl * p; exs += cl; pos += s
    40	                closed_or_reversed = abs(pos) < 1e-9 or (pos > 0) != (cdir > 0)
    41	                if closed_or_reversed and es > 0 and exs > 0:
    42	                    evw = en / es; xvw = ex / exs
    43	                    g = cdir * (xvw - evw) / evw
    44	                    out.append((c, cdir, ets, ts, evw, xvw, g))
    45	                    # A reversal closes the old position and opens the residual
    46	                    # opposite leg at this same fill price.
    47	                    residual = pos
    48	                    en = es = ex = exs = 0.0
    49	                    if abs(residual) < 1e-9:
    50	                        pos = 0.0
    51	                    else:
    52	                        pos = residual; ets = ts; cdir = 1 if residual > 0 else -1
    53	                        en = abs(residual) * p; es = abs(residual)
    54	    return out

     1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
     2	"""Candle-close mark source for the forward-OOS, sourced from the fills-reconstructed 1m candles
     3	(app/data/hl_s3_candles_1m_hot, fresh to today-1d) instead of the LAGGING asset_ctxs exact-mark archive
     4	(hyperliquid-archive, only published to ~06-29). Alberto 2026-07-09: the fills+candles were backfilled this
     5	morning, so pricing the OOS off candle closes unblocks it now.
     6	
     7	candle_mark_at(coin, ts_ms): last 1m candle CLOSE at/before ts_ms (asof-backward), None past a staleness cap.
     8	Same asof-backward contract as leadlag_clean_rank_sim.mark_at, so forward_oos_hot can swap sources cleanly.
     9	
    10	CAVEAT: candle close = last-TRADE price; asset_ctxs = exact oracle MARK. Small bps-level basis. Use
    11	basis_report() to quantify it on the overlap window (both sources exist through ~06-29) before trusting the
    12	OOS verdict. Read-only.
    13	"""
    14	from __future__ import annotations
    15	import glob, sys
    16	from bisect import bisect_right
    17	from pathlib import Path
    18	import numpy as np, pandas as pd
    19	
    20	REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent.parent
    21	CANDLE_DIR = REPO / "app" / "data" / "hl_s3_candles_1m_hot"
    22	MARK_MAX_AGE_MS = 5 * 60_000   # 1m candles: a close older than 5m => no coverage (matches mark_at spirit)
    23	
    24	_idx: dict[str, tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray] | None] = {}
    25	
    26	
    27	def _load(lo_ms: int | None = None, hi_ms: int | None = None) -> None:
    28	    """Build per-coin (ts_ms, close) asof index from the candle parquets, once."""
    29	    if _idx:
    30	        return
    31	    files = sorted(glob.glob(str(CANDLE_DIR / "20??????.parquet")))
    32	    if not files:
    33	        return
    34	    frames = []
    35	    for f in files:
    36	        df = pd.read_parquet(f, columns=["coin", "timestamp_utc", "close"])
    37	        frames.append(df)
    38	    allc = pd.concat(frames, ignore_index=True)
    39	    allc = allc.dropna(subset=["coin", "timestamp_utc", "close"])
    40	    allc["timestamp_utc"] = allc["timestamp_utc"].astype("int64")
    41	    allc = allc.sort_values(["coin", "timestamp_utc"], kind="mergesort")
    42	    for coin, g in allc.groupby("coin", sort=False):
    43	        _idx[coin] = (g["timestamp_utc"].to_numpy(), g["close"].to_numpy(dtype="float64"))
    44	
    45	
    46	def candle_mark_at(coin: str, ts_ms: int):
    47	    if not _idx:
    48	        _load()
    49	    m = _idx.get(coin)
    50	    if m is None:
    51	        return None
    52	    ts, px = m
    53	    i = bisect_right(ts, ts_ms) - 1
    54	    if i < 0:
    55	        return None
    56	    if ts_ms - int(ts[i]) > MARK_MAX_AGE_MS:
    57	        return None
    58	    return float(px[i])
    59	
    60	
    61	def basis_report(coins: list[str], lo_ms: int, hi_ms: int, step_ms: int = 15 * 60_000):
    62	    """Compare candle_mark_at vs asset_ctxs mark_at across [lo,hi] for `coins`; return per-coin bps basis."""
    63	    sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
    64	    import leadlag_clean_rank_sim as S
    65	    rows = []
    66	    for c in coins:
    67	        diffs = []
    68	        t = lo_ms
    69	        while t <= hi_ms:
    70	            cm = candle_mark_at(c, t)
    71	            am = S.mark_at(c, t)
    72	            if cm and am and am > 0:
    73	                diffs.append((cm - am) / am * 1e4)  # bps
    74	            t += step_ms
    75	        if diffs:
    76	            a = np.array(diffs)
    77	            rows.append({"coin": c, "n": len(a), "med_bps": float(np.median(a)),
    78	                         "mean_abs_bps": float(np.abs(a).mean()), "p95_abs_bps": float(np.percentile(np.abs(a), 95))})
    79	    return pd.DataFrame(rows)

     1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
     2	"""Live-mark source for OOS/selection: reads the real-time 1m mark store
     3	(app/data/hl_mark_1m_hot, collected by data_pipeline/hl_live_mark_collector.py from HL metaAndAssetCtxs).
     4	This is the EXACT oracle mark, captured continuously -> for any window on/after the collector started it

     6	and candle_marks.candle_mark_at, so forward_oos_hot can swap sources cleanly (--mark-source live).
     7	
     8	Coverage begins 2026-07-09; does NOT retro-cover the 06-30..07-08 gap (we didn't record it then). Read-only.
     9	"""
    10	from __future__ import annotations
    11	import glob
    12	from bisect import bisect_right
    13	from pathlib import Path
    14	import numpy as np, pandas as pd
    15	
    16	REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent.parent
    17	MARK_DIR = REPO / "app" / "data" / "hl_mark_1m_hot"
    18	MARK_MAX_AGE_MS = 5 * 60_000   # a mark older than 5m => no coverage (poll cadence is 1m)
    19	
    20	_idx: dict[str, tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray] | None] = {}
    21	_field = "markPx"
    22	
    23	
    24	def load(field: str = "markPx") -> None:
    25	    """Build per-coin (ts_ms, price) asof index from the live-mark parquets. field in {markPx,oraclePx,midPx}."""
    26	    global _field
    27	    _field = field
    28	    _idx.clear()
    29	    files = sorted(glob.glob(str(MARK_DIR / "20??????.parquet")))
    30	    if not files:
    31	        return
    32	    frames = [pd.read_parquet(f, columns=["coin", "timestamp_utc", field]) for f in files]
    33	    allm = pd.concat(frames, ignore_index=True).dropna(subset=["coin", "timestamp_utc", field])
    34	    allm["timestamp_utc"] = allm["timestamp_utc"].astype("int64")
    35	    allm[field] = pd.to_numeric(allm[field], errors="coerce")
    36	    allm = allm.dropna(subset=[field]).sort_values(["coin", "timestamp_utc"], kind="mergesort")
    37	    for coin, g in allm.groupby("coin", sort=False):
    38	        _idx[coin] = (g["timestamp_utc"].to_numpy(), g[field].to_numpy(dtype="float64"))
    39	
    40	
    41	def live_mark_at(coin: str, ts_ms: int):
    42	    if not _idx:
    43	        load()
    44	    m = _idx.get(coin)
    45	    if m is None:
    46	        return None
    47	    ts, px = m
    48	    i = bisect_right(ts, ts_ms) - 1
    49	    if i < 0:
    50	        return None
    51	    if ts_ms - int(ts[i]) > MARK_MAX_AGE_MS:
    52	        return None
    53	    return float(px[i])
    54	
    55	
    56	def coverage():
    57	    if not _idx:
    58	        load()
    59	    rows = []
    60	    for c, v in _idx.items():
    61	        if v is None or len(v[0]) == 0:
    62	            continue
    63	        rows.append({"coin": c, "n": len(v[0]),
    64	                     "first": pd.Timestamp(int(v[0][0]), unit="ms", tz="UTC"),
    65	                     "last": pd.Timestamp(int(v[0][-1]), unit="ms", tz="UTC")})
    66	    return pd.DataFrame(rows)
